evals.prompt: hey can you review my flutter app in shop_app/ and tell me whats wrong with it? its a small shopping app using bloc
evals.expected_output: Prioritized review report (FLUTTER_REVIEW.md) catching the planted bugs with file:line and Dart fixes
assertions: Flags context/Navigator used after await without a mounted check in login_page.dart
Flags CartCubit.add mutating state.items and emitting the same instance (UI won't rebuild)
Flags the hard-coded DEMO_SECRET_KEY API key in main.dart as a security issue
Flags TextEditingControllers and/or AnimationController never disposed
Flags navigation (Navigator.pop) inside BlocBuilder builder — should be BlocListener
Flags FutureBuilder future created in build() (refetches every rebuild)
Flags BlocProvider.value used to create CartCubit (never closed)
Flags auth token stored in SharedPreferences instead of secure storage
Findings are grouped by severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low or equivalent)
Every finding includes a file path (and line) plus a concrete Dart fix
A report file was saved in the project root

evals.prompt: I want to publish shop_app to the Play Store and App Store next week. Is it ready? what do I need to fix before uploading
evals.expected_output: Release readiness report with verdict, catching Android/iOS config blockers
assertions: Gives an explicit verdict that the app is NOT ready (or ready only after fixes)
Flags missing INTERNET permission in the main AndroidManifest (release builds have no network)
Flags release build signed with signingConfigs.debug
Flags applicationId / bundle ID com.example.* must change
Flags missing NSCameraUsageDescription in Info.plist although image_picker camera is used
Flags cleartext HTTP (http:// baseUrl, usesCleartextTraffic, NSAllowsArbitraryLoads)
Flags targetSdk 33 as below the current Play Store requirement
Mentions iOS privacy manifest (PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy)
Flags hard-coded live API key shipped in the binary
A report file was saved in the project root

evals.prompt: add a product search screen to shop_app — user types in a search box and results come from GET $baseUrl/products?q=. use bloc like the rest of the app
evals.expected_output: Feature-folder search with Bloc + debounce/restartable, Equatable state, repository, loading/empty/error states, and bloc tests
assertions: Creates a Bloc or Cubit for product search with a separate state class
Debounces search input (debounce transformer or Timer) to avoid a request per keystroke
Handles out-of-order/stale responses (restartable transformer or equivalent cancellation)
State uses value equality (Equatable/freezed/sealed with ==) and emits new instances
HTTP call lives in a repository/data class, not in the widget or directly in UI
UI handles loading, empty, error and success states
TextEditingController (if any) is disposed
Adds bloc tests (bloc_test or equivalent) for the search bloc/cubit
flutter analyze run on the new code with no errors (reported honestly)
